title: read-package-json is no longer supported
summary: npm states that read-package-json is no longer supported and recommends @npmcli/package-json.

constraints: Preserve package normalization, extra metadata loading, error handling, file paths, warnings, and callback or promise timing relied on by callers.

steps.title: Move to @npmcli/package-json
steps.instructions: Replace the dependency and reads with @npmcli/package-json, adapting its promise-based API and normalized result shape.

verification.purpose: Run valid, malformed, missing, and normalized package metadata tests.
